findings.issue: 何が is read なにが, not なんが. 何 is only なん before d/t/n sounds and counters (なんだ, なんの); before が as interrogative subject it is なに.
findings.current: あのこうさてんでなんがおこったのか。
findings.suggested: あのこうさてんでなにがおこったのか。

findings.issue: Token 何 (interrogative subject before が) is read なに in this context, not なん.
Romaji propagates the wrong reading なんが; should be naniga.
Two reading errors: １杯 is いっぱい (sokuon + p, never いちばい, which would be 一倍 'double'), and ２００円 is にひゃくえん, not digit-by-digit にれいれいえん.
findings.current: あのころわこーひーいちばいがにれいれいえんだったよ。
findings.suggested: あのころわこーひーいっぱいがにひゃくえんだったよ。

findings.issue: Counter 杯 after １ is read ぱい (１杯 = いっぱい), not ばい.
２００ (a price in yen) is read にひゃく; にれいれい (digit-by-digit) is never used for prices.
Romaji propagates both wrong readings: ichibai should be ippai, nireirei should be nihyaku.
Numeral １ before 杯 geminates: read いっ (part of いっぱい), not いち, in this context.
Wrong literal reading of the idiom: クビにする is Xにする 'to make [someone] into a neck' (beheading metaphor), not 'to put around the neck'. Misidentifies the にする construction.
findings.current: クビにする ('to put around the neck') is an idiom for 'to fire,'
findings.suggested: クビにする (literally 'to make [someone] into a neck') is an idiom for 'to fire,'

findings.issue: Same wrong literal reading in Portuguese: 'pôr no pescoço' treats に as locative; the construction is Xにする = 'tornar [alguém] pescoço'.
findings.current: クビにする ('pôr no pescoço') é uma expressão idiomática para 'demitir'
findings.suggested: クビにする (literalmente 'tornar [alguém] pescoço') é uma expressão idiomática para 'demitir'

findings.issue: 'ponho no pescoço' is an inaccurate literal mirror: クビにする is resultative Xにする ('torno [você] pescoço'), not putting something on a neck.
findings.current: Se [você] fizer tal coisa, [eu te] ponho no pescoço (te demito), porque, viu.
findings.suggested: Se [você] fizer tal coisa, [eu te] torno 'pescoço' (te demito), porque, viu.

findings.issue: 歴史 means 'history' only; 'story' is not a sense of 歴史 (likely contamination from pt 'história'). Misleading gloss for learners.
Spurious 'you know' — the sentence ends in plain べきだ with no final particle (よ/ね/ぜ); the literal mirror invents a structural element. lit_pt correctly has none.
findings.current: You should start a new life, you know.
findings.suggested: You should start a new life.

findings.issue: Leftover editorial artifact in both note languages: "(glosa 'to print' incorreta)" / "(the gloss 'to print' is wrong)" references a gloss that no longer exists; remove from pt-BR and en notes.
findings.current: し é する; com たら forma したら ('se fizer'), condicional simples (glosa 'to print' incorreta)
findings.suggested: し é する; com たら forma したら ('se fizer'), condicional simples

findings.issue: Note claims 見て is 'contracted before ごらん' (contraída) — no contraction occurs; 見て is the regular て-form. Only ごらん is a shortening (of ご覧なさい), as its own note says. Fix en note too.
findings.current: forma て de 見る (見て, contraída antes de ごらん)
findings.suggested: forma て de 見る (見て), usada antes de ごらん
